name: app-factory
description: Portable AI software-development factory with incremental context, autonomous next-action routing and capability-based execution backends.

interface.shortDescription: Recover context, choose an executor, build, verify and continue automatically.
interface.longDescription: A portable software-development factory that activates from software intent, recovers incremental repository context and autonomous state, then routes each action to the lightest capable backend, preferring the current agent and GitHub CI before a full local executor.
defaultPrompt: I want to create a software system. Route it through App Factory automatically.
Resume this software project and continue with the lightest capable execution backend.
Use GitHub CI for deterministic verification before escalating to a local executor.
